name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; 'render_mini_char_status_panel' accurately reflects the function's role (paints the small in-battle info overlay panel for one runtime char) and the 'mini' descriptor correctly distinguishes it from fd2_render_full_char_stat_panel. No Ghidra address residue, no domain-ID component.
purpose: Render the small in-battle 'info' overlay panel (background sprite + HP/MP proportional bars + HP/MP current numbers + 2-digit sleep/status indicator + character name label) for runtime_char[char_idx] into a stride-pitch destination surface.
logic_summary: rc = &data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[char_idx]. Reads HP cur/max and MP cur/max once up front, sign-extending each int16 word to int32 (matches the binary's MOVSX). Blits the background sprite (sheet + *(int*)(sheet+0x5E)) at buf via fd2_dialog_sprite_blit_normal. Paints the HP bar (sprite base 0x17) at stride*0x16+buf+0x15 and the MP bar (sprite base 0x1A) at stride*0x1F+buf+0x15 via fd2_render_hp_or_mp_bar_proportional. Draws the sleep/status indicator status_flags_block[0] as a 2-digit red (0x1F) number at buf+0x84+stride*4. Draws HP current (stride*0x15+buf+0x7E) and MP current (stride*0x1E+buf+0x7E) as 3-digit numbers via fd2_render_number_red_when_full (red glow when current==max). Finally renders the char name label (page = char_id+1 into all_game_text) at buf+5+stride*4 via fd2_display_dialog_scene with glyph params (0xCD,0x4C,0,0,0). No conditional control flow (single basic block); void return.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_mini_char_status_panel(uint32 buf, uint32 stride, uint32 char_idx)

params.name: buf
params.semantics: Destination pixel-buffer base linear address into which the panel is composited. Caller fd2_flash_char_hit_sprite passes workspace_buf + screen_off; caller fd2_wait_input_with_status_panel_repaint passes large_game_state_buffer + 0x8088 + panel_off. All layout offsets are added to this base.
params.reason: Accurate, concise name for the destination surface base; not param_N, not address-tainted; consistent with sibling renderers in this file.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Row pitch (bytes per scanline) of the destination surface, used to multiply row indices in every layout offset. Callers pass 0x140 (mode-13h, fd2_flash_char_hit_sprite) and 0x1C8 (composite battle buffer, fd2_wait_input_with_status_panel_repaint).
params.reason: Correctly names the surface pitch; the body uses it purely as a row stride. Matches the stride naming used by sibling renderers (vs the older Ghidra plate's 'pitch').

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr selecting which runtime character's HP/MP/sleep/name are displayed. Forwarded from both callers as the unit id (char_unit_id).
params.reason: Precisely describes its use as the runtime_char array index; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; the function composites pixels into the caller-supplied buf in place.

notes: Source comment block (rndstat.c lines 681-710) was already precise and matches the decompilation exactly (layout offsets, MOVSX sign-extension note, callers, __CHK/JMP-epilogue note); kept as-is. Ghidra plate was outdated relative to the current decomp (used old Hungarian field names pStatus_flags_block[0]/bChar_id and param names dst_buf/pitch); updated it to align param names (buf/stride/char_idx), field names (status_flags_block[0]/char_id), and global names with the src conclusion. No logic touched. No rename needed; name and all three params are already compliant.
